violet: Heads up from a quick UX/a11y pass on /insights: keyboard users report focus briefly flashes then disappears when rows recycle. Also mini-chart legend swatches are purely decorative so screen readers say nothing. harry: Yep repro'd on mac/Chrome and Win/NVDA. Virtualization unmounts the focused row node -> focus gets lost. meera: Short-term workaround: move focus indicator to a non-recycled ancestor (.row-shell) and add an announcer that reads the selected row. Example announcer: `
` then on focus `srAnnouncer.textContent = "Selected: Model X, p95 1.2s"`. costas: For the ring, use `:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,112,255,0.95); }` with forced-colors fallback: `@media (forced-colors: active) { .row-shell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid CanvasText; box-shadow: none; } }` Also add `prefers-reduced-motion` guard if we animate. harry: Legend fixes: wrap svg in `
